parameters.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,collections
rev='e3c1782b96'; base=rev+'~10'
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,rev,'--'],text=True).splitlines()
paths=[p for p in paths if p.endswith(('.ts','.tsx','.mts','.cts'))]
plan_counts=collections.Counter(); package_counts=collections.Counter(); blame_counts=collections.Counter(); entries=[]
for p in paths:
    r=subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{rev}:{p}'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if r.returncode: continue
    for lineno,line in enumerate(r.stdout.splitlines(),1):
        for m in re.finditer(r'@plan\s*:?\s*([^\s*]+)',line):
            raw=m.group(1).rstrip('.,;)\]}')
            # A slash-delimited annotation names each plan independently.
            ids=raw.split('/') if raw.startswith('PLAN-') else [raw]
            package='/'.join(p.split('/')[:2]) if p.startswith('packages/') else '(outside packages)'
            package_counts[package]+=1
            try:
                blame=subprocess.check_output(['git','blame','--line-porcelain','-L',f'{lineno},{lineno}',rev,'--',p],text=True,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                short=blame.splitlines()[0].split()[0][:7]
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                short='(unavailable)'
            blame_counts[short]+=1
            for pid in ids: plan_counts[pid]+=1
            entries.append((p,lineno,raw,short))
print('MARKER_OCCURRENCES',len(entries))
print('PLAN_ID_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(plan_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('PACKAGE_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(package_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('BLAME_SHORT_HASH_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(blame_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('TOTAL',len(entries))
print('PLAN_SUM',sum(plan_counts.values()))
PY

paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,rev,'--'],text=True).splitlines()
paths=[p for p in paths if p.endswith(('.ts','.tsx','.mts','.cts'))]
plan_counts=collections.Counter(); package_counts=collections.Counter(); blame_counts=collections.Counter(); entries=[]
for p in paths:
    r=subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{rev}:{p}'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if r.returncode: continue
    for lineno,line in enumerate(r.stdout.splitlines(),1):
        for m in re.finditer(r'@plan\s*:?\s*([^\s*]+)',line):
            raw=m.group(1).rstrip('.,;)\]}')
            # A slash-delimited annotation names each plan independently.
            ids=raw.split('/') if raw.startswith('PLAN-') else [raw]
            package='/'.join(p.split('/')[:2]) if p.startswith('packages/') else '(outside packages)'
            package_counts[package]+=1
            try:
                blame=subprocess.check_output(['git','blame','--line-porcelain','-L',f'{lineno},{lineno}',rev,'--',p],text=True,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                short=blame.splitlines()[0].split()[0][:7]
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                short='(unavailable)'
            blame_counts[short]+=1
            for pid in ids: plan_counts[pid]+=1
            entries.append((p,lineno,raw,short))
print('MARKER_OCCURRENCES',len(entries))
print('PLAN_ID_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(plan_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('PACKAGE_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(package_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('BLAME_SHORT_HASH_COUNTS')
for k,v in sorted(blame_counts.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('TOTAL',len(entries))
print('PLAN_SUM',sum(plan_counts.values()))
